settings.heading: From the tree to your cup
settings.intro: What ceremonial grade means to me, step by step.

settings.title: Single origin
settings.text: It stays in the place it came from. It isn't hybridized or mass-farmed, and no pesticides are used.

settings.title: Made by hand
settings.text: Picked, fermented, sun-dried, roasted, de-shelled, and ground into paste. There's no factory.

settings.title: Cared for
settings.text: The people who grow it pray over it at each step. That care is part of why it's called ceremonial.

settings.heading: What I test, and what I don't claim
settings.text:
Cacao can carry trace heavy metals from the soil. I'll post lab results for each batch here so you can see them yourself.

HHaven cacao isn't USDA Organic certified, and I don't use a Fair Trade label. I'd rather tell you who grew it and how I buy it.
